domain.name: Low-Dose Radiation Physics and Radiobiology
domain.description: Entities and relationships connecting the physical properties of low-dose ionising radiation to its biological effects at the cellular and tissue level.
domain.guiding_question: What are the physical mechanisms and radiobiological principles governing the effects of low-dose ionising radiation on living systems?

entity_types.name: RADIATION_TYPE
entity_types.description: Type of ionising radiation (X-ray, gamma, alpha, neutron, beta)

entity_types.name: LET
entity_types.description: Linear energy transfer — energy deposited per unit track length

entity_types.name: TRACK_STRUCTURE
entity_types.description: Spatial pattern of ionisation events along a radiation track

entity_types.name: BIOLOGICAL_EFFECT
entity_types.description: Observable biological outcome (cell death, mutation, transformation)

entity_types.name: RBE
entity_types.description: Relative biological effectiveness of a radiation type

entity_types.name: BYSTANDER_EFFECT
entity_types.description: Radiation effects in cells not directly irradiated

relationship_types.name: HAS_LET
relationship_types.description: A radiation type has a characteristic LET value

relationship_types.name: PRODUCES
relationship_types.description: A radiation track produces a biological effect

relationship_types.name: SCALES_WITH
relationship_types.description: RBE scales with LET or dose
